status: asset animation specification; runtime implementation not included
values: Suggested timings only. Source probabilities, fever duration and activation rules remain editable.

punch-hit.trigger: machine body hit during punch fever
punch-hit.engine: body recoil 3–5 px and return; keep shadow fixed; flash alpha

reward.engine: editable gold popup; gold×2 and click×2 are different events

auto-pickup.engine: item travels toward bin or counter; no ability gain

expiry.engine: pulse and fade at runtime-configured expiry; no fixed lifetime in art

dispense.engine: toggle hatch only; animate item downward; keep frame registration

fever-status.engine: timer and bar derive from runtime. Orange target and normal/special caps are unresolved.
